Done. Delivered **`todo_ollama-qwen3.8-flash-next-125b-a6b-q4_01.html`** — a single self-contained file (406 lines, ~9.9 KB) with all HTML, CSS, and JS inline, and no external dependencies. The embedded script passes a syntax check.

**Features covered:**
- **Add todos** — input + Add button (Enter works too); empty/whitespace input is ignored
- **Mark complete** — custom checkbox or clicking the text toggles strikethrough styling
- **Delete** — × button on each item
- **Filters** — All / Active / Completed toggle group with active-state highlighting, plus filter-aware empty-state messages
- **localStorage persistence** — saved on every change, safely parsed/validated on load (survives corrupt data gracefully); unique key tied to the file name

Extras included: item counter ("N items left"), "Clear completed" button, slide-in animation, and accessible labels (`aria-label`, `aria-live`). Just open the file in any browser to use it.
